blurb: Guests can ride their own snowmobile through the Alaskan backcountry on groomed trails in a private gold mining operation with views of glaciers, ice caves, and 7000-foot peaks. Summer tours include rafting and hiking in Portage Valley with views of glaciers and wildlife. Guides have Wilderness First Responder training and provide interpretative hikes and safe adventures for all ages and experience levels.
